title.rendered: Announcement on registering to purchase learning materials for English Course 2, Course 3_CLC (Cohort 2025) and Course 3 Plus (Cohort 2024) in the 1st Semester, Academic Year 2026-2027 (Phase 2)

content.rendered:
Based on the study plan for the 1st Semester of the Academic Year 2026-2027 for full-time undergraduate classes.

The Institute announces the registration to purchase learning materials for English Course 2, Course 3_CLC (Cohort 2025), and Course 3 Plus (Cohort 2024) in the 1st Semester of the Academic Year 2026-2027 (Phase 2) as follows:

1. Target audience: Full-time undergraduate students of cohorts 2024 and 2025 who have registered for English Course 2, Course 3_CLC, and Course 3 Plus in the 1st Semester, Academic Year 2026 – 2027 within their training program.

2. Study plan and Timetable: Details are attached (students can check their personal Timetable on the Edusoft Training Management System or their PTIT S-Link account).

3. Learning materials: Students are required to equip themselves with the following learning materials:

ED (English Discoveries) Account: Students register for an ED (English Discoveries) account provided by IIG Vietnam to study English online according to the program (students can choose either a 6-month or 12-month account package).

Course 2 textbook for the English Course 2 subject. The English Course 3_CLC subject does not use a textbook.

For English Course 3 Plus: Students register for a TOEIC OLPC account – an online TOEIC review and test preparation program (OLPC 2 Modules – Module 2 & Module 3).

Note: If a student’s current ED account is still valid, they can continue using it for the next English module; however, if the remaining time is insufficient to complete the entire new module, they must register for an extension when the old account expires.

4. Cost of learning materials:

ED account: 90,000 VND / 6 months or 1,120,000 VND / 12 months.

TOEIC OLPC account: 1,140,000 VND.

Course 2 textbook: 81,000 VND.
(The above prices have been subsidized by IIG Vietnam under the cooperation program between the Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology and IIG Vietnam).

5. Time and method for registering to purchase the ED account:

Registration and payment period: From August 19, 2026, to August 25, 2026.

Payment method: The Institute will collect the fees for the ED account and textbooks from students via the identified payment code system (Students use their personal PTIT S-Link account to declare information and pay via the identified code at: https://slink.ptit.edu.vn/ and select “Đăng ký sách ED” / “Register for ED books”).

The Institute informs the students and requests that students in all classes comply with this announcement.

If students encounter any difficulties regarding the registration for books and the ED account, please contact this phone number: 024.33.528.122.

If students have any issues during the payment process for books and the ED account, please contact this phone number: 024.33.113.166.

Best regards!
